# OgaPay

> A Nigerian marketplace for paid tasks and freelance services. People earn by completing tasks or selling services; businesses post jobs and pay only for work they approve. Payments in Naira or USDC, held in escrow.

Website: https://ogapay.app
Operator: OgaPay Technologies Ltd
Contact: support@ogapay.app
Official channels: https://x.com/Ogapayhq, https://t.me/ogapay (no other accounts speak for OgaPay)

## How it works

- Posting a job: the poster sets a brief, the proof required, the reward per worker and the number of workers. The budget plus a 10% platform fee is locked in escrow before anyone starts. Workers keep 100% of the reward shown.
- Doing a job: workers take a job, submit proof, and are paid into their OgaPay wallet when the poster approves. Work the poster leaves unreviewed is approved automatically, after 3 days at most.
- Cancelling: a job nobody has taken can be cancelled; the budget and fee go back to the poster.
- Requirements a poster can set: verified identity (KYC level), minimum OgaScore, minimum rank, a connected X account.
- Store: people sell services and digital products. The buyer's payment is held until they confirm delivery, or 3 days after the seller marks the order delivered. No store fees.
- Communities: groups with members, a chat, a leaderboard and a feed of jobs. Owners and admins can post jobs only their members can take.
- Contests: prizes for the top places; the poster ranks the winners after the end date, or the earliest entries win 3 days later.
- Blog: posts can be liked, commented on and tipped (a naira transfer to the author).
- Money: wallets hold Naira, USDC and SOL (USDC and SOL on Solana). Withdrawals go to a Nigerian bank (1.5% fee, minimum ₦100) or a crypto wallet (1%) and need identity verification. Transfers between OgaPay users are free.
- Vault: every 12 hours (00:00 and 12:00 UTC) platform fees in the vault are shared with $PAY holders by how much they hold. Payouts vary with activity. Nothing on OgaPay is financial advice.

## Developer API

Docs and keys: https://ogapay.app/developer
Base URL: https://ogapay.app/api/v1/dev
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer oga_live_...` (create a key on the developer page; every key reads, a key with write access can also post jobs and pay for work)

- GET /me: your account (username, name, OgaScore, KYC level)
- GET /jobs: open public jobs, newest first (category, search, page, limit)
- GET /jobs/:id: one public job
- GET /my/jobs: jobs you posted (page, limit)
- GET /my/submissions: work you submitted, with status and payment (page, limit)
- GET /my/balance: your wallets (balance, locked, available)
- GET /my/transactions: your wallet history (page, limit)

With write access:
- POST /jobs: post a job, a contest or a members-only community job; the budget and 10% fee go from your wallet into escrow (30 an hour per key)
- GET /jobs/:id/submissions: work sent for your job, with the proof
- POST /submissions/:id/approve: pay the worker from escrow (rating?, feedback?)
- POST /submissions/:id/reject: reason required; the place opens again
- POST /jobs/:id/winners: pay a contest's winners after it ends, 1st place first
- POST /jobs/:id/cancel: cancel a job nobody has taken; budget and fee come back

No key can withdraw or send money.
